name: Famine
summary: Risk of famine persists in Sudan; El Niño threatens Somalia
state: UNICEF says the risk of famine persists in Sudan, where 19.5 million people face acute food insecurity. FEWS NET flags El Niño-driven risks in the Horn and southern Africa, including famine risk in southern Somalia if floods are extreme. No current IPC Phase 5 classification was confirmed as of 3 Nov.
for_you: No direct action; aid agencies publish appeals for affected areas.

sources.title: UNICEF — Risk of famine persists in Sudan

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
